free_text.label: study_title
free_text.text: Three-dimensional morphologic and molecular atlases of murine nasal vasculatures [Mouse_Nasal_SmartSeq]

free_text.label: study_abstract
free_text.text: To investigate heterogeneity of murine nasal Prox1+ vasculatures, GFP+ cells from Prox1-GFP mouse nasal tissue were FACS sorted and single-cell RNA seq was performed Overall design: Nasal Prox1+ cells were FACS sorted and single-cell libraries were made
